description: 燕尾杀：白王走入死角，黑后对角线将死
explanation_en: The white king steps into a confined square, where its own pieces limit its flight and the black queen delivers dovetail mate.

intro.popup: 💡 燕尾杀：注意白王的位置。黑后将从对角线发动燕尾杀——王被己方两子封住斜向逃格，形如燕尾。
intro.popup_en: 💡 Dovetail mate: Watch the white king's position. The black queen will attack along a diagonal; the king's own pieces block its diagonal escape squares, forming a dovetail shape.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Kc2走入封闭位置，Qd3#完成燕尾杀。棋形与上题类似，多熟悉此形。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Kc2 enters the confined square and Qd3# completes dovetail mate. The position resembles the previous example; practice recognizing the pattern.

moves.popup: 白王走c2，陷入封闭位置，逃格被己方棋子封死。
moves.popup_en: The white king moves to c2 and enters a confined position, with its own pieces blocking the escape squares.

moves.popup: 黑后Qd3#，燕尾杀！王被己方棋子封住，后从对角线将死。
moves.popup_en: Qd3# is dovetail mate! The king is hemmed in by its own pieces as the queen gives mate along the diagonal.
